officialTitle: Vaginal Injection of Platelet Rich Plasma for Sexual Dysfunction: A Randomized Control Trial

arms.label: Participants receiving a PRP Injection
arms.description: Participants will receive a single injection of 4-5cc autologous platelet-rich plasma into the distal anterior vaginal wall after blood draw.

arms.label: Participants receiving Saline Injection
arms.description: Participants will receive a single injection of 4-5cc sterile saline into the distal anterior vaginal wall after blood draw (blood sample will be discarded).

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, 18 years of age or older, presenting with sexual dysfunction
* FSFI total score ≤ 26.5
* English speaking and literate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling or unable to provide informed consent
* Pregnant or less than 12 weeks postpartum
* Known history of bleeding disorder
